limitations_and_boundaries: All fibroblasts were cultured and serially passaged on rigid matrices before transfer to hydrogels; potential influence of mechanical memory cannot be assessed.
Global Taz haploinsufficiency in prior bleomycin model prevented ascribing attenuated fibrosis solely to fibroblast function.
In vitro stiffness range (0.4–25 kPa) may not fully capture in vivo heterogeneity.
Adoptive transfer model uses immortalized NIH3T3 fibroblasts, not primary IPF fibroblasts.
YAP/TAZ knockdown experiments used siRNA pools; off-target effects cannot be excluded.
PAI-1 is one of many YAP/TAZ targets; other pathways likely contribute.
